user_direction: Another circuit/layout improvement round; first define bounded experiments and validation scope.

authorization.exact_user_selection: Approve the proposed bounded layout trial and 64 diagnostic transient runs (recommended).
authorization.selection_was_made_after: The user was shown fixed 3.8/4.2 um distances, a 5 percent incremental area target, a planning-only 9.69 percent projection, at most two candidate DRC attempts, at most 64 new transients, stop-on-regression conditions and private-only completion.
authorization.execution_freeze: Implementation must record exact hashes of this authorized plan, private generator and pre-native geometry/route deltas before actual candidate DRC and before SPICE.

research_question: Can pair-specific conservative single-row spacing reduce the adopted material bounding-box area by at least another 5 percent without structural or sampled functional regression?

baseline.layout_identity: adopted single-row-a1, not the earlier 4.8 um compact control
baseline.baseline_native_proof: Hash-verified existing adopted-candidate proof and extracts, explicitly reused not rerun.

planning_evidence.method: Read-only analysis of adopted static-envelope-diagnosis.json, placement/pin records, native generator and routing implementation; no geometry generated or native tool invoked.
planning_evidence.limitations: These are conservative hypotheses from archived envelopes, not complete shape-distance validation. Pre-native full-material/contact/pad/escape/bridge/shield audit and actual native DRC are required. Well classes do not certify matching or physical-model accuracy.

one_candidate_geometry.wide_wide_adjacency: Not present in retained order. Detect and reject unexpected adjacency instead of applying ordinary/wide assumptions.
one_candidate_geometry.left_pair_placement: Negative of corresponding radius; reflect_x remains +1.

mandatory_endpoint_updates.other_M3_buses: Derive extrema from actual translated existing lane endpoints, retaining the same endpoint extension and bus tracks.

not_allowed: Another row, reordering, folding, diffusion sharing or common-centroid claim.
Bus-y, bus-width, local terminal escape relative geometry or body-pad bridge changes.
Guard/shield removal, cropping, rule waiver or electrical retuning.
Post-result pitch search or a second architectural candidate.

area_objective.definition: Bounding box of all nonempty GDS material polygons, including wells/body contacts/guards/shields; exclude TEXT only.

pre_execution_requirements: Verify unchanged live/local public head, clean tree, seal and all baseline scientific/raw/model sources.
Verify existing approved native tool binary/shared-object/PDK hashes, source Git pins and runtime versions before use; stop if unavailable or changed.
Read full exact native rectangles, actual translated terminal routes, contacts/pads, four retained PFET body bridges and grounded shields, on both left and right sides.
Use exact integer-grid placement and relative-pin invariants, not floating subtraction equality.
Confirm every proposed local interval against complete applicable recorded rules and at least the retained 0.20 um planning safety.
If the proposed fixed map is incompatible, stop with evidence; do not silently enlarge, shrink or change it.
Freeze one complete private generator/protocol/geometry-delta/source-pin record before the first actual candidate native DRC and before simulation.
Use private adapter/source copies; do not modify frozen public generators, PCells, original protocols, netlists or archive evidence.

native_validation.first_attempt: One new candidate with the fixed map.
native_validation.second_attempt: Optional single routing-implementation repair, only within all fixed placement, relative-escape, bridge, track, width and device invariants. No retuning. Not an obligation to continue after failure.
native_validation.style: sky130A 1.0.608, full named drc(full), actual euclidean checks
required_checks: Actual full-material bbox and incremental area target.
Required actual GDS/MAG material layers and connected gate landings.
All 27 MOS, ordered 15 ports, bulk and body connectivity.
All 27 native junction signatures equal adopted baseline.
Fresh C export: genuine scaling, material, DC anchors and passive connectivity.
Fresh RC export: genuine scaling, material, DC anchors and passive connectivity.

limited_matched_simulation.energy: Same published full-cycle core energy, 20-30 ns; excludes drivers/controller/calibration.
limited_matched_simulation.measurement_helpers: Existing pinned published measure and validate_waveform, unchanged.
comparison_stop_conditions: Any new wrong or unresolved key at 1 ns or 2 ns, or loss of a previously correct key.
A recorded 2 ns latency increase above 0.02 ns at any matched physical key.
Full-cycle core energy increase above 1 percent at any matched physical key.
Any unexpected experiment key, rerun, substitution, third step or expanded corner/input set.

execution_environment.native: Existing approved Ubuntu-24.04 retained private-prefix Magic 8.3.684 / Netgen 1.5.323 / open_pdks aa3fc21, sky130A 1.0.608; exact seven binary/shared-object/PDK hashes and source pins required.
execution_environment.simulation: Existing Windows ngspice 47, Python 3.12.10 and NumPy 2.2.6, already approved 400 raw model files at official revision f62031a1be9aefe902d6d54cddd6f59b57627436.
execution_environment.new_scratch: Only newly created individually named owned short-path Windows/WSL scratch roots, after existence/capacity checks.
execution_environment.cleanup: Only exact newly owned scratch paths after persistent archive/member/hash verification. Keep prior tools/models/audits/failures/history untouched.

end_of_round.next_decision: If the exact candidate passes area/native/limited nonregression gates, separately consider full45 paired qualification; do not adopt from four points per mode/layout.
end_of_round.mandatory_caveat: Archived RC-deck outcomes; model physical fidelity not yet qualified
